title_en: Chinese History (10/20): Building the Ming Great Wall
note_en: 一旦 A，就 B means "once A happens, B follows": 一旦发现敌情，就可以通过烟火迅速传递消息 "once the enemy was spotted, the news could be sent quickly by smoke and fire." 一旦 introduces a condition that may or may not happen, and 就 marks the immediate result. Note that 就 comes after the subject of the second clause (if there is one), not at the very start like English "then."
